full_track.tags: K-Pop with elements of musical theater and pop-rock. Male vocals perform with theatrical delivery, shifting between chest voice and belted high notes. The arrangement features a prominent piano playing rhythmic block chords and melodic flourishes. An electric bass plays syncopated lines that follow the kick drum. The drum kit uses a crisp snare and a driving kick pattern. A bright string section provides staccato accents and soaring legato counter-melodies. Distorted electric guitar enters during the chorus to provide harmonic density with power chords. The track is in the key of E Major at 128 BPM in 4/4 time.
